business_summary.text: Xtranet Technologies Limited is an integrated technology solution provider delivering digital infrastructure and technology solutions to governments, PSUs, and private enterprises across data center infrastructure, enterprise applications, digital services, and proprietary platforms.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue target of ₹500+ Cr, implying 35-40% YoY growth
Data center segment targeting 35-40% annual growth to maintain 50% revenue share
Active bid pipeline of ₹1,200 Cr; 40-45% at advanced stage, 30% conversion expected in next quarter
Tax rate expected to be around 25% for the next two years
Hardware price inflation is a risk; company has mitigated by holding inventory
